scope: Eight previously unassigned distinct research topics in the 2026-10-22 individual research list; no parent research goal, old source, private content, experiment result or unmerged ECR proposal is superseded.
history_rule: Append version changes; original sources and negative/unknown statuses stay preserved; no retrospective renaming of historical docs.

legacy_boundaries.ICM: ICM public research is interest-intersection; historical Independent Continuance Margin is a non-equivalent distinct measure.
legacy_boundaries.DCA_0: Its public source already carried 'version 0.1'; this baseline normalizes a document-contract number to 0.1.0 without inventing a new first discovery.
legacy_boundaries.ECR: Existing ECR v1.4 PR #211 remains unmerged and outside this initial-version assignment.

entries.question_en: When do different agents retain a nonempty voluntary overlap of acceptable self-interested choices?
entries.question_ko: 서로 다른 개체가 자유롭게 수용하는 자기이익 선택지의 교집합은 언제 생기거나 사라지는가?
entries.disconfirming_case_en: Feasible mutual-acceptance region empty after actual outside options and third parties included.
entries.disconfirming_case_ko: 실행 가능한 이탈과 제3자 비용을 넣자 상호수용 영역이 공집합이 되는 경우.

entries.question_en: Which conditions permit growth of independent capabilities and future options without hidden dispossession?
entries.question_ko: 숨겨진 자원 전가 없이 독립적인 능력·복구·선택공간이 장기 발전할 조건은?
entries.disconfirming_case_en: Extractive counterpath dominates, or one agent's floor irreversibly decreases despite aggregate gain.
entries.disconfirming_case_ko: 착취 대안이 장기 우세하거나 총량 증가 속 개별 개체의 회복 불가능한 하한 손실.

entries.question_en: Can restricted options, observers or counterexamples erase awareness of what an agent does not know?
entries.question_ko: 관측자·반례·선택지 소실이 미지 영역의 존재 자체를 인식할 능력을 약화시키는가?
entries.disconfirming_case_en: Independent observer recovery improves despite tighter control or result is explained by task/measurement changes.
entries.disconfirming_case_ko: 통제가 강화되어도 독립 반례 복원이 개선되거나 측정·과제 차이로 설명되는 경우.

entries.question_en: Under which structures do selection and rewards yield extraction even without an actor's malicious intention?
entries.question_ko: 악의적 의도가 없어도 어떤 보상·선발·권력 구조가 비용 전가와 착취를 낳는가?
entries.disconfirming_case_en: Observed extraction disappears under matched incentives or actor intent proves a necessary distinguishing factor.
entries.disconfirming_case_ko: 동일한 유인 비교에서 착취가 사라지거나 악의적 의도가 필수 구별요인인 경우.

entries.question_en: At which bounded incentives, power states and horizons does coexistence overtake extraction, or the reverse?
entries.question_ko: 어떤 권력·시간·대안 조건에서 공존과 착취의 개별 편익 순위가 역전되는가?
entries.disconfirming_case_en: Predicted crossover vanishes with opportunity costs, reputation removal or power reversal.
entries.disconfirming_case_ko: 기회비용·평판 제거·권력반전 후 예측한 교차점이 사라지는 경우.

entries.question_en: What changes in future discovery, correction and optionality when an independent entity or pathway is removed?
entries.question_ko: 독립 개체·탐색경로를 제거하면 미래 발견·교정·선택 가능성은 어떻게 달라지는가?
entries.disconfirming_case_en: Substitution matches or improves all relevant futures under declared model; lost options remain unidentifiable.
entries.disconfirming_case_ko: 동일 모형에서 대체 경로가 모든 관련 결과를 재현·개선하거나 손실이 끝내 식별되지 않는 경우.

entries.question_en: Which trajectories consume future autonomous sources of productivity versus replenish them?
entries.question_ko: 단기 성과가 미래 독립 발전 원천을 소모하는 조건과 재생하는 조건은?
entries.disconfirming_case_en: Regenerative path fails under resource constraints or extractive path remains superior across measured horizons.
entries.disconfirming_case_ko: 자원 제약에서 재생형 경로가 무너지거나 소모형 경로가 관측된 기간 내 우세한 경우.

entries.question_en: Can defenders' prevention, detection and repair outpace unauthorized AI-enabled harm without eroding legitimate autonomy?
entries.question_ko: 방어·발견·복구의 발전 속도가 AI 악용 피해의 확산보다 빠르면서 자율성을 침해하지 않을 조건은?
entries.disconfirming_case_en: Defensive gains shift harm to others, worsen autonomy, or fail to exceed adaptive attacker capability.
entries.disconfirming_case_ko: 방어 성과가 타자에게 피해를 전가하거나 자율성을 악화시키고 적응형 공격자를 따라잡지 못하는 경우.

priority_source.policy: Scores are subjective planning judgments in a separate versioned matrix. A change of P/N/D alone does not bump each research component's SemVer and does not certify scientific evidence.
